experiment: Plan A — Density-aware training crops + SAHI inference
motivation: Advisor feedback: clustering and cropping images based on density to improve tiny aerial person detection.

method.training: YOLOv12-s trained on 640x640 crops generated from original 4000x3000 HERIDAL images (person-centered + random crops, ~4500 total)
method.inference: SAHI sliced inference on original 4000x3000 val images, 640x640 tiles, 0.2 overlap, NMS post-process

evaluation: pycocotools COCO eval on original 4000x3000 val (313 images)

naive_sahi_no_crop_training.note: fails due to training-inference resolution mismatch

key_insight: Naively applying SAHI inference to a model trained on resized images fails badly because of distribution shift. Training on native-resolution crops aligns the training and inference distributions, unlocking the full benefit of density-aware slicing.
